high_level_description: This image depicts a statue situated on a paved area near a beach. The statue is of a person standing upright, dressed in formal attire, with hands clasped together in front of the body. The base of the statue is a rectangular pedestal with inscriptions written in Tamil script. The pedestal appears to be made of stone or concrete and is adorned with small decorative elements. The setting is an open area with a paved walkway leading up to the statue. The background features a wide expanse of sandy beach stretching towards the horizon, where the ocean meets the sky.
